subject: Transportation Systems
title: The Akashi Kaikyō Bridge
description: One-minute skill: The Akashi Kaikyō Bridge.

hook.text: Japan's Akashi Kaikyō Bridge has the longest suspension span on Earth: 6,532 feet between towers.

buildup.text: It crosses a strait with typhoons, earthquakes, and 9-knot currents. The engineering had to be extreme.

discovery.text: Each anchorage weighs 350,000 tons. The main cables contain enough wire to circle the Earth seven times.

twist.text: During construction, the 1995 Kobe earthquake shifted the towers apart by three feet. Engineers adapted.

climax.text: Opened in 1998, it carries six lanes of traffic and is designed to withstand 180 mph winds.

punchline.text: An earthquake moved it. They finished it anyway.

quiz.question: What is the Akashi Kaikyō Bridge's record?
options: Longest suspension bridge main span in the world
